title: HydroBoot -Master Flash 1/2-in to 4-in x 8-in Epdm Rubber Vent and Pipe Flashing
seoTitle: HydroBoot Rubber Vent & Pipe Flashing for 1/2"-4" Pipes
description: Protect your roof with HydroBoot EPDM rubber vent & pipe flashing. Fits 1/2"-4" pipes, offering durable, leak-proof performance. Easy to install!

sections.html:
Hydro boot is made from EPDM material. The hydro boot can be separated and installed

around hydro poles, antenna poles etc.… where the roof boot cannot be installed by sliding

it over the pole. Hydro boot protects from water intrusion and weathering against the

elements.
